title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High-schooler Kazunari Usa moves into a boarding house when his parents are transferred for work. His fellow tenants are an odd group of adults, and among them is Ritsu Kawai, the quiet, bookish senior he has a crush on. The comedy follows shared-house life and Usa's slow approach to Ritsu; after misunderstandings the two become a couple in his second year.
life_message: Living patiently alongside odd people teaches you to care for them, and love grows slowly through everyday kindness.
